audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for post-calf presence crisis, ornaments removed, tent outside camp, face-to-face speech, Moses' intercession for presence, glory request, and goodness/name proclamation preview.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, Go, go up from here, you and the people whom you brought up from land of Egypt, to land that I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed I will give it.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ עֲלֵ֣ה מִזֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֣ה וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱלִ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה

verses.restored: I will send a messenger before you, and I will drive out Canaanite, Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, Hivite, and Jebusite.

familiar.text: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

modern.text: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

original.text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י לְפָנֶ֖יךָ מַלְאָ֑ךְ וְגֵֽרַשְׁתִּ֗י אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי

verses.restored: Go to land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up in your midst, for you are stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on way.

familiar.text: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

modern.text: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”

original.text: אֶל אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֶֽעֱלֶ֜ה בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ כִּ֤י עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֨רֶף֙ אַ֔תָּה פֶּן אֲכֶלְךָ֖ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ

verses.restored: When the people heard this harmful word, they mourned, and no one put on ornaments.

familiar.text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

modern.text: When the people heard these bad tidings, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הָעָ֗ם אֶת הַדָּבָ֥ר הָרָ֛ע הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּתְאַבָּ֑לוּ וְלֹא שָׁ֛תוּ אִ֥ישׁ עֶדְי֖וֹ עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Say to children of Israel, You are stiff-necked people; if one moment I go up in your midst, I would consume you. Now take down your ornaments from you, and I will know what I will do to you.

familiar.text: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

modern.text: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I should go with you for a single moment, I would destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.’”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַתֶּ֣ם עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֔רֶף רֶ֧גַע אֶחָ֛ד אֶֽעֱלֶ֥ה בְקִרְבְּךָ֖ וְכִלִּיתִ֑יךָ וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹרֵ֤ד עֶדְיְךָ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְאֵדְעָ֖ה מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽךְ

verses.restored: Children of Israel stripped themselves of ornaments from Mount Horeb onward.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

modern.text: So the Israelites stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward. The Tent of Meeting

original.text: וַיִּֽתְנַצְּל֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת עֶדְיָ֖ם מֵהַ֥ר חוֹרֵֽב

verses.restored: Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside camp, far from camp, and called it tent of meeting; everyone seeking YHWH would go out to tent of meeting outside camp.

familiar.text: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

modern.text: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.

original.text: וּמֹשֶׁה֩ יִקַּ֨ח אֶת הָאֹ֜הֶל וְנָֽטָה ל֣וֹ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה הַרְחֵק֙ מִן הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְקָ֥רָא ל֖וֹ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֙ כָּל מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה יֵצֵא֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה

verses.restored: It happened when Moses went out to tent, all people rose and stood, each at opening of one's tent, and watched after Moses until he entered tent.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

modern.text: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses until he entered the tent.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּצֵ֤את מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל הָאֹ֔הֶל יָק֨וּמוּ֙ כָּל הָעָ֔ם וְנִ֨צְּב֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֣תַח אָהֳל֑וֹ וְהִבִּ֨יטוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד בֹּא֖וֹ הָאֹֽהֱלָה

verses.restored: When Moses entered tent, pillar of cloud would descend and stand at opening of tent, and he would speak with Moses.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.

modern.text: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ הָאֹ֔הֱלָה יֵרֵד֙ עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן וְעָמַ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְדִבֶּ֖ר עִם מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: All the people saw pillar of cloud standing at opening of tent, and all the people rose and worshiped, each at opening of one's tent.

familiar.text: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

modern.text: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.

original.text: וְרָאָ֤ה כָל הָעָם֙ אֶת עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן עֹמֵ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְקָ֤ם כָּל הָעָם֙ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֥תַח אָהֳלֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his companion. Then he returned to camp, but his attendant Joshua son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from midst of tent.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

modern.text: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent. The Promise of God’s Presence

original.text: וְדִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל פָּנִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וּמְשָׁ֨רְת֜וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ נַ֔עַר לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֹֽהֶל

verses.restored: Moses said to YHWH, See, you say to me, Bring up this people, but you yourself have not made known to me whom you will send with me. Yet you said, I know you by name, and also you have found favor in my eyes.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

modern.text: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל יְהוָ֗ה רְ֠אֵה אַתָּ֞ה אֹמֵ֤ר אֵלַי֙ הַ֚עַל אֶת הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֔נִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלַ֖ח עִמִּ֑י וְאַתָּ֤ה אָמַ֨רְתָּ֙ יְדַעְתִּ֣יךָֽ בְשֵׁ֔ם וְגַם מָצָ֥אתָ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָֽי

verses.restored: Now please, if I have found favor in your eyes, make known to me your ways, so that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.

familiar.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

modern.text: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”

original.text: וְעַתָּ֡ה אִם נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ הוֹדִעֵ֤נִי נָא֙ אֶת דְּרָכֶ֔ךָ וְאֵדָ֣עֲךָ֔ לְמַ֥עַן אֶמְצָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּרְאֵ֕ה כִּ֥י עַמְּךָ֖ הַגּ֥וֹי הַזֶּֽה

original.text: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר פָּנַ֥י יֵלֵ֖כוּ וַהֲנִחֹ֥תִי לָֽךְ

verses.restored: For by what then shall it be known that I have found favor in your eyes, I and your people? Is it not in your going with us, so that we are distinguished, I and your people, from every people upon face of ground?

modern.text: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”

original.text: וּבַמֶּ֣ה יִוָּדַ֣ע אֵפ֗וֹא כִּֽי מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמֶּ֔ךָ הֲל֖וֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ֣ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְנִפְלֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמְּךָ֔ מִכָּ֨ל הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה

modern.text: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”

familiar.text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

modern.text: “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

modern.text: The LORD continued, “There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock,

modern.text: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”

original.text: וַהֲסִרֹתִי֙ אֶת כַּפִּ֔י וְרָאִ֖יתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָ֑י וּפָנַ֖י לֹ֥א יֵרָאֽוּ

translation_notes: Presence/face (panim) is central: Moses refuses a promised land without YHWH's presence.
Tent outside camp marks presence after rupture before tabernacle completion; seeking YHWH requires going out.
Face-to-face in v.11 and not seeing face in v.20 are held in narrative tension; preserve both rather than harmonizing too quickly.
Moses asks to know YHWH's ways and see glory; YHWH answers with goodness, name, grace, and compassion.
Land promise language remains source-preserved with ethical audit flags from prior chapters.
safety_note: Do not use presence language to erase accountability after idolatry. The chapter holds rupture, mourning, intercession, and mercy together; Moses seeks presence for the whole people, not private spiritual status.
